using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Reflection;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.iOS.Xcode;

// Compiled by ios-postprocess.test.sh against the real Unity PBX library.
class IosPostprocessContract
{
    static int Main(string[] args)
    {
        try
        {
            var configure = typeof(CMPPostProcessBuild).GetMethod("ConfigureUnityBridge", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Static);
            Check(configure != null, "Missing Unity-owned bridge configuration");
            var project = new PBXProject();
            project.ReadFromString(@"{
                archiveVersion = 1; objectVersion = 56;
                objects = {
                    A00000000000000000000010 = {isa = PBXProject; mainGroup = A00000000000000000000011; productRefGroup = A00000000000000000000012; buildConfigurationList = A00000000000000000000013; targets = (); };
                    A00000000000000000000011 = {isa = PBXGroup; children = (A00000000000000000000012,); sourceTree = ""<group>""; };
                    A00000000000000000000012 = {isa = PBXGroup; children = (); name = Products; sourceTree = ""<group>""; };
                    A00000000000000000000013 = {isa = XCConfigurationList; buildConfigurations = (A00000000000000000000014, A00000000000000000000015,); defaultConfigurationName = Release; };
                    A00000000000000000000014 = {isa = XCBuildConfiguration; buildSettings = {}; name = Debug; };
                    A00000000000000000000015 = {isa = XCBuildConfiguration; buildSettings = {}; name = Release; };
                }; rootObject = A00000000000000000000010;
            }");
            var main = project.AddTarget("Unity-iPhone", "app", "com.apple.product-type.application");
            var framework = project.AddTarget("UnityFramework", "framework", "com.apple.product-type.framework");
            project.AddSourcesBuildPhase(main);
            project.AddSourcesBuildPhase(framework);
            string bridge = args[1];
            var source = Path.Combine(args[0], bridge);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(source));
            File.WriteAllText(source, "import Foundation\n");
            var file = project.AddFile(bridge, bridge, PBXSourceTree.Source);
            project.AddFileToBuild(main, file);
            configure.Invoke(null, new object[] { project, args[0] });
            Check(File.Exists(source), "Bridge was moved out of the Unity export");
            Check(!Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(args[0], "Pods")), "Bridge configuration created Pods");
            Check(project.FindFileGuidByProjectPath(bridge) == file, "Existing bridge file reference was replaced");
            Check(project.GetBuildPropertyForAnyConfig(framework, "SWIFT_VERSION") == "5.0", "UnityFramework lacks Swift 5");
            Check(project.GetBuildPropertyForAnyConfig(framework, "DEFINES_MODULE") == "YES", "UnityFramework does not define its module");
            Check(project.GetBuildPropertyForAnyConfig(framework, "SWIFT_OBJC_INTERFACE_HEADER_NAME") == "UnityFramework-Swift.h", "Wrong Swift generated header");
            Check(project.GetBuildPropertyForAnyConfig(main, "ALWAYS_EMBED_SWIFT_STANDARD_LIBRARIES") == "YES", "App does not embed Swift runtime");
            Check(project.GetBuildPropertyForAnyConfig(framework, "ALWAYS_EMBED_SWIFT_STANDARD_LIBRARIES") == "NO", "Framework embeds a duplicate Swift runtime");
            var first = project.WriteToString();
            configure.Invoke(null, new object[] { project, args[0] });
            Check(project.WriteToString() == first, "Repeated configuration duplicates PBX build entries/settings");
            var competingBridge = bridge.StartsWith("Libraries/com.sourcepoint.unitycmp/")
                ? "Libraries/ConsentManagementProvider/Plugins/iOS/Source/SwiftBridge.swift"
                : "Libraries/com.sourcepoint.unitycmp/Assets/ConsentManagementProvider/Plugins/iOS/Source/SwiftBridge.swift";
            var competingSource = Path.Combine(args[0], competingBridge);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(competingSource));
            File.WriteAllText(competingSource, "import Foundation\n");
            try { configure.Invoke(null, new object[] { project, args[0] }); throw new Exception("Duplicate exported bridges were accepted"); }
            catch (TargetInvocationException error) { Check(error.InnerException.Message.Contains("Multiple exported SwiftBridge.swift"), "Duplicate source error is not explicit"); }
            File.Delete(competingSource);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(args[0], "Unity-iPhone.xcodeproj"));
            project.SetBuildProperty(main, "IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET", "15.0");
            project.WriteToFile(Path.Combine(args[0], "Unity-iPhone.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj"));
            var podfilePath = Path.Combine(args[0], "Podfile");
            File.WriteAllText(podfilePath, "platform :ios, '15.0'\n");
            CMPPostProcessBuild.ConfigurePodsBeforeInstall(BuildTarget.iOS, args[0]);
            var podfile = File.ReadAllText(podfilePath);
            Check(podfile.Contains("Gem::Version.new('15.0')"), "Pod hook does not use exported app deployment floor");
            CMPPostProcessBuild.ConfigurePodsBeforeInstall(BuildTarget.iOS, args[0]);
            Check(File.ReadAllText(podfilePath) == podfile, "Repeated pre-install callback duplicates hook");
            Check(!Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(args[0], "Pods")), "Pre-install callback directly creates or mutates Pods");
            File.Delete(source);
            try { configure.Invoke(null, new object[] { project, args[0] }); throw new Exception("Missing exported bridge was accepted"); }
            catch (TargetInvocationException error) { Check(error.InnerException.Message.Contains("SwiftBridge.swift"), "Missing source error does not name SwiftBridge.swift"); }
            Console.WriteLine("PASS: real Unity PBX bridge configuration, idempotence, duplicate and missing source failures");
            return 0;
        }
        catch (Exception error) { Console.Error.WriteLine("FAIL: " + error); return 1; }
    }
    static void Check(bool condition, string message) { if (!condition) throw new Exception(message); }
}
